Stack her pressure-point effect on the same enemy, then use the saved S3 Prithee, let this be an enlightening bout. She also works independently outside Burn teams.
messages.速度差で強化: 各スキルは、自分の速度が対象より高いほどコイン威力が上がる(速度: **Speed-difference bonuses**: Each skill gains Coin Power the faster she is than the target (+1 per 2 Speed difference, up to 2). Her Defense skill gains the same bonus when she is faster than the attacker.
messages.呼吸→クイックのループ: バトルパッシブ「草炎玉球」(憤怒×2・傲慢×2・保有・: **Poise→Haste loop**: Through the combat passive Virescent Pyrojade (2 Wrath and 2 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ), she gains 1 Haste next turn at Turn End for every 5/3 Poise Potency she has, up to 2. She gains Poise Potency on Clash Win with S2 Virescent Flame Palm (3 Poise) and S3 (5 Poise).
messages.点穴-ドンキホーテ: 同じパッシブにより、基本攻撃スキルで最後に的中した対象に、: **Nerve Strike - Don Quixote**: Through the same passive, the last target hit by her basic attack skills receives Nerve Strike next turn, once per turn, up to 3. Her Clash Power and Base Power against that target rise with the number of stacks. Applying it to a different target removes the previous stacks.

messages.序盤はS1で呼吸回数を確保し、S2のマッチ勝利で呼吸威力を貯めて、パッシブのクイ: Early on, secure Poise Count with S1, build Poise Potency by winning Clashes with S2, and collect the passive's Haste. Keep hitting the same enemy to stack Nerve Strike to 3, then unleash the S3 you have been saving. Treat Burn as a bonus rather than her core. She can fight on Speed difference and Nerve Strike alone, even outside Burn teams.
